Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! New Zealand Women are in huddle and they spread out now to take their respective positions. Lizelle Lee and Laura Wolvaardt are the openers for South Africa Women. These two will be key for South Africa Women. New Zealand Women, on the other hand, will be looking for early wickets. Frances Mackay will look to do the same as she has ball in her hand. Here we go...
...THE RUN CHASE…

Right then, South Africa Women need 229 runs to make it four wins on the trot. The conditions are pretty good for batting and South Africa will fancy chasing this total, especially after their successful chase against England in the last game. New Zealand Women have a tough task ahead of them. However, they have runs on the board and it is always crucial in a crunch World Cup game. Can the home team deliver a spirited bowling performance? We shall find out. Stay tuned.

Ian Smith is near the pitch. Says that he cannot find any signs of damage to be used by the spinners, no footmarks. Informs that the light roller has done a few rounds on the pitch. Feels that Frances Mackay is going to be the key. Also, Ian mentions that South Africa Women should not fear anything on this pitch in pursuit of 229.

Amelia Kerr, who played a good knock of 42 runs, comes up for a quick word. She says that it's disappointing to not bat the full 50 overs. Adds that they had a good platform set and talks about the importance of someone batting through. Feels that the wicket is a touch slow and they will take this total and go out there to defend. States that they have a great bowling attack and hopes to get off to a good start. Mentions that slower balls are effective and the spinners can play a role. Tells that there will be good energy on the field as they love the company of each other and hopes to put out a good display.

The White Ferns will think that they had this innings under control till the 40th over mark. However, once Sophie Devine departed after a brilliant knock of 93 runs, other batters just failed to get going. Throughout the innings though there were just two partnerships of note and apart from Amelia Kerr and Maddy Green, other batters failed to support their skipper. New Zealand Women would be in a bit of shock after that collapse in the death overs and it remains to be seen how they go about their business with the ball as the pitch is quite good and New Zealand Women were well on the course to get around 280 at one point in time.

The South African bowling has been setting up games for them throughout this World Cup. The story has continued in this encounter as well as they have restricted New Zealand to a below-par total. The opening bowling pair of Shabnim Ismail and Marizanne Kapp started off on a bright note and got an early wicket. However, the bowlers lost the plot after that, the skipper, Sune Luus, provided the breakthrough to bring them back into the game. Though the game-changing phase of the game was when Ayabonga Khaka got rid of the set Sophie Devine and that shifted the momentum. Thereafter, the South African bowlers were all over White Ferns and eventually managed to bowl them out for 228.

Six wickets for 30 runs! What a superb display of death bowling this has been from South Africa Women. The momentum kept swinging from one side to another for the most part of the innings but some brilliant death bowling meant that South Africa will go back as the happier side into the break. The home side now needs a big effort with the ball to pull off a victory here.

OUT! CAUGHT AT POINT! Slower one, on a length and outside off, Jess Kerr reaches out and hits it uppishly towards point. Marizanne Kapp takes a fine low catch and New Zealand Women are bowled out for 228 - wasting 13 precious deliveries.
Commentary.Howout: c Marizanne Kapp b Ayabonga Khaka

Commentary.Commentary: Full toss around leg, it's nudged down to fine leg for a run.
Slower length ball around off, it's pushed to covers for a single.
A yorker around leg, Jess fails to put it away and is hit on the boot.
Fuller and around off, it's sliced away to point.
Ayabonga Khaka comes back into the attack now.
Width there outside off, Kerr tries to cut but gets a bottom edge onto it. The ball rolls wide of the keeper and they cross.
FOUR! Slapped! Short in length and wide outside off, Jess Kerr reaches out and whacks it to the deep point fence.
Jess Kerr is the last batter in.

OUT! Sound of timber! The stumps have taken quite a beating in this match, this is the fifth bowled dismissal. Shabnim Ismail keeps it on a length and in the line of the stumps, at 122 kph, Lea Tahuhu steps back and tries to heave it over the leg side but misses. The sticks are obliterated and New Zealand Women have now lost their last 5 wickets for 23 runs.
Perfect! Yorker around off, Lea Tahuhu does well to dig it out back towards the bowler.
Slower and fuller around off, Frances Mackay defends it gently to point and steals a single.
Full toss on middle, it's flicked straight to mid-wicket.
No hat-trick but what an over by Kapp! Full and around off, angling in, Lea defends it back to the bowler.
Lea Tahuhu is the next batter in. She will face the hat-trick ball!

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! One brings two for Marizanne Kapp. She hurls it across on a fuller length outside off, Hannah Rowe tries to drive it through the line but it goes below her bat to the keeper. Trisha Chetty collects and doesn't appeal much but Marizanne Kapp is appealing. Nothing from the umpire.​ Sune Luus takes the DRS and the UltraEdge detects a spike as the ball leaves the toe end of Rowe's bat. Marizanne Kapp is on a hat-trick.
Commentary.Howout: c Trisha Chetty b Marizanne Kapp

Commentary.Commentary: Hannah Rowe is the next batter in.

OUT! BOWLED! Full tosses certainly have been wicket-taking deliveries. It's a juicy one, around middle and leg at 114 kph, Brooke Halliday tries to swing across the line but misses. It thuds on her pads and gets deflected onto the stumps. Marizanne Kapp has her first wicket and smiles as she raises her arms. New Zealand Women continue to lose wickets in the end overs.
Fuller and around off, driven down to mid off.
Fires in a very full ball, around leg and angling down, Brooke Halliday tries to work it around but misses. It takes her pads and rolls behind to the keeper.
Serves it on a length around middle, Frances Mackay works it to deep square leg and picks up a single. Brooke Halliday wants the second run but her partner is not interested.
A single to finish the over! A length delivery, around off. Frances Mackay steers it towards third man for a single.
Now a dot ball! This is superb stuff from the experienced bowler! A slower delivery, slightly on the shorter side outside off. Frances Mackay looks to pull but misses.
Just a single again! Lands it on a length and around off. Brooke Halliday pushes it towards the off side for a single.
On a length, on off. Frances Mackay defends it towards the off side and takes a quick single.

Good, very good slower delivery. Lands it on a length, outside off. It's an off-cutter and it beats the outside edge of Brooke Halliday's blade as she looks to push at it. The keeper fails to collect it cleanly and a bye is taken.
Goes for a yorker on middle. Frances Mackay just about manages to dig it out towards the leg side for a single.

Excellent over from Kapp! Another length delivery and she does not provide any room for the batter to work with. Frances Mackay looks to defend this off the front foot but gets the inside edge onto her pads. A run is taken as it rolls towards the off side.
Tight line! Lands this on a length, on off. Frances Mackay defends this towards the off side.
Kapp bangs this one short on middle. Brooke Halliday pulls but gets a top edge. The ball falls short of the fine leg fielder and a single is taken.
Good timing! Overpitched on off. Brooke Halliday drives it through covers and gets a couple before the fielder in the deep cuts it off.
Back of a length, on off. Brooke Halliday mistimes her pull shot to mid on.
A fullish delivery on middle. Brooke Halliday pushes it to mid on.
Marizanne Kapp is back on.
Dot ball to end the successful over from Shabnim Ismail! A good-length delivery, on off. Frances Mackay blocks this off the front foot.
On a good length, outside off. Frances Mackay pushes at it but misses.
Shabnim Ismail goes searching for a yorker but it ends up being a full toss, Frances Mackay tries to work it on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Frances Mackay is the number 8 batter for New Zealand Women.

OUT! BOWLED! What a comeback by Shabnim Ismail! She is pumped up and it's another wicket for South Africa Women! Lands this on a length around off and it nips back in sharply at 119 kph. Martin is cramped for room and is beaten by both pace and movement. She is late to get her bat down and it sneaks through to rattle the stumps. Shabnim Ismail gives a sendoff to Katey Martin who also responds with some gestures of her own. Things heating up certainly. New Zealand are losing the plot at the backend.
FOUR! Provides the width and powerfully put away for a boundary! This is full and outside off. Martin drills it through extra cover.
A fullish delivery on middle. Martin pushes it to mid off.
Shabnim Ismail is back into the attack. 1 for 13 in her 6 overs so far.
Served quicker and flatter around off. Brooke Halliday chopped it to short third man.
Fuller outside off. Martin drives it to square off the wicket on the off side for a single.
A tossed-up delivery on off. Brooke Halliday skips down the track and takes it on the full. She drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
It's pushed quicker on middle, Martin makes a bit of room and pushes it towards covers for a single.
Shorter and flatter on off. Brooke Halliday punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up on off. Martin works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Pitches this up on leg and slower in pace. Martin works it towards fine leg for a single.
200 up! Fuller and wider outside off, Brooke Halliday crunches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Pitches it up and around off, Brooke drives it to covers.
Fuller in length, around off, Martin drives it to covers where Lizelle Lee makes a diving stop. Cannot prevent the single though.
Katey Martin walks in next.

OUT! KNOCKED HER OVER! A big, big wicket for South Africa Women! Ayabonga Khaka nails a perfect yorker to get rid of White Ferns' skipper. A yorker on middle at 98 kph. Devine stays deep in her crease and looks to heave it across the line but misses. The ball shatters the stumps after getting deflected off her pads and this can make a difference of good 20-30 runs to the final score. Brilliant stuff from Ayabonga Khaka and you need deliveries like these to get rid of a player of Sophie Devine's calibre.
Khaka bowls a low full toss outside off. Brooke Halliday chases it and slices this towards third man for a single.
End of Powerplay 2! Now, 5 fielders can be placed outside the circle until the end of the innings.
SIX! High and handsome! Marizanne Kapp serves it slow and around off, it's in the slot for Sophie Devine who takes a big stride forward and launches it over long on. Moves into the 90s now!
Back of a length, around off, Devine stays on the back foot and taps it down to point.
Kapp comes from 'round the wicket and nails her yorker around off, Brooke Halliday squeezes it out off the outer half and sends it to third man for one.
A low dipping delivery, landing fuller around off, Brooke Halliday drives it square of the wicket on the off side and comes back for the second run.
A touch short and around off, cutting away, Brooke Halliday plays it down to point.
Angles in a length ball around leg, Devine drags her shot down to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Play and a miss! Cleverly bowled again. Slower and on a length outside off, Brooke Halliday flashes her blade at it early and misses.
A leg cutter, on a length around off, Devine waits and forces it to sweeper cover for a single.
Fractionally short and around leg, Brooke Halliday plays the short-arm pull to deep square leg for a run.
Outside off, on a length and again on the slower side, Brooke Halliday cuts but finds the fielder at point.
Shortish and on off, Devine goes back and slaps it through covers for a run.

Slower one to begin the spell, full and on middle, Devine tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball drops near the popping crease, Sophie watches it closely and then her partner but doesn't get any signal to steal a quick run.
Another bowling change. Ayabonga Khaka (6-1-22-1) is back into the attack.
Slower one, full and around off, Brooke Halliday gently eases it in the gap at covers for two.
Short and around off, Devine drags her pull shot through mid-wicket for a single.
On a good length around off, defended down safely.
Angling across the batter, outside off, dabbed down to third man for a run. The fielder in the deep slipped but didn't concede any extra run.

Shout for an lbw! Not given and South Africa Women review. A touch short in length, around middle and leg and angling down, Devine tries to work it on the leg side but misses. She is pinged above the knee roll on the back leg and the appeal is made. It's not entertained and South Africa Women take the DRS. The UltraEdge finds no bat and the Ball Tracking shows that it's missing the stumps. One review is lost. The batters had crossed so a leg bye added to the total.
Marizanne Kapp is brought back into the attack. 25 runs from her 6 overs so far.
Back of a length, around off and cutting in, Sophie Devine goes on her toes and defends it to point.
FOUR! Nailed! This time Brooke Halliday has packed her shot with full power. Short and around off, she turns inside the crease and hammers it to the deep square leg fence.
Shortish and around off, Brooke Halliday sits back and lofts it over square leg for a couple of runs. A calculative risk, didn't try to hit hard.
Angling away from the left-hander, on a length, Brooke Halliday pushes inside the line and misses. Nearly brought the slip fielder into play.
Slip in place.
Shorter length, outside off again. Devine cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Pitches this one up, on off. Devine drives it to the cover fielder in the ring.
Back of a length, outside off. Devine cuts it to cover-point.
Shabnim Ismail is brought back into the attack.
Shorter and outside off. Devine cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.

Confusion again! Fuller and around off, Brooke Halliday drives it through covers and finds the gap. They take two, hesitate for the third but then cross. The throw comes to the bowler's end, Chloe Tryon tries to catch it but fails.
A flatter delivery, outside off. Brooke Halliday cuts it to the cover-point fielder in the ring.
Tossed up, on off. Brooke Halliday drives it to covers.
Brooke Halliday is the next batter in.

OUT! Run out! Maddy Green eventually runs out of her luck and is found short in the replays. The 80-run stand has been broken and South Africa Women would be aiming to finish strong from hereon. Tossed up, around off and spinning away, Sophie Devine taps it down to point and looks for a run. Maddy Green hesitates just for a moment and that probably has cost her. Laura Wolvaardt parries it to the keeper who takes the bails off quickly. It's referred upstairs and Green is given the red signal.

Is this a run-out? It looks close. The square leg umpire has taken it upstairs. The replays roll in and they show that Green is short of her crease. So the partnership is broken and Green has to walk back,
Flatter and around off, turning away, Maddy punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Play and a miss! A genuine leg spinner, landing full around off and spinning away, Sophie Devine tries to sweep but misses.
FOUR! Poor delivery and Devine takes full advantage of it!
Green skips down the track and Luus drags this one short around off. Green punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Pushed quicker and fuller outside off. Green pushes it to point.
This is shorter on middle. Devine pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A flatter delivery on leg. Green tucks it to fine leg and takes a single.

Drinks break. This match has ebbed and flowed a little too much. South Africa Women started strongly in Powerplay 1 but then the pair of Sophie Devine and Amelia Kerr took the momentum away. The Protea women again bounced back to strike twice in the span of 4 deliveries but once again the White Ferns have stolen the rhythm with the help of the ongoing partnership. A couple of catches offered by Maddy Green went down and that has not helped South Africa Women. Another thing is the absence of Masabata Klaas who has not returned to the field after completing her second over. Let's see which team finishes strongly in the end overs. Sune Luus to bowl after the break...
Short and wide outside off. Devine rocks back and cuts it to deep extra-cover for a couple.
A flatter and quicker delivery on middle and leg. Green goes back to a full delivery again and takes a single as she pushes it towards covers.
Slower in the air, on off. Green pushes it uppishly towards mid off.
Goes fuller on leg. Devine sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
Short and wide outside off now. Green cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
So many short deliveries have been bowled today. This is again short on off. Devine pulls it to long on for a single.
Short and wide outside off. Devine cuts it hard to sweeper cover for a single. She will keep the strike as well.
FOUR! Bang! 150 comes up for New Zealand Women! Full toss around leg, Sophie Devine picks it up off her pads and blazes it past the fine leg fielder for a boundary.
On a length, around off. Green steers it towards sweeper cover for a single.

Dropped by Marizanne Kapp! She drops a sitter here! Fullish delivery on middle, Green clips it aerially towards short mid-wicket. Kapp there just fails to grab a straightforward catch and the bowler is in quite a shock and rightly so.
WIDE! Tries a slower delivery but it is a bit too wide outside off. Green leaves it alone and the umpire calls it a wide.
Nails a yorker this time on middle. Green digs it out.
Back of a length, outside off. Devine cuts it to deep extra cover for a single.
Ayabonga Khaka is back on. 1 for 14 in her 5 overs so far.
Flatter arm ball around off, Maddy defends it back to the bowler who makes a diving stop to her right.
Goes slightly shorter on off. Green punches this towards deep extra cover and calls for the second run immediately and comes back for it comfortably.
Tossed up and fuller on off. Devine pushes it to covers for a single.
Another one on the shorter side, on middle. Green pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter and flatter on off. Devine punches it to long on for a single.
A flatter delivery, outside off. Green cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Change in bowling. Chloe Tryon is back on.
Goes on the back foot to a short ball and punches it to sweeper cover for a run. 10 from the over!
WIDE! This is sliding down the leg side. Green looks to clip it but misses.

Another full toss on off. Green goes for a big slog again but gets the bottom half of her blade. A couple of runs are taken towards the deep mid-wicket region as Tazmin Brits cuts it off. The 50-run stand comes up!
Shorter and flatter outside off. Green cuts it to covers this time.
FOUR! That's a gift for Green and helps her to get a boundary under her belt! A full toss on middle, Green skips down the track and slams it towards long on for a boundary.
Tossed up on off. Devine hits it to long on for a single.
Fuller delivery on off. Green goes back to this one and takes a single by pushing it towards the off side.
EDGY FOUR! Marizanne Kapp digs it in short, around leg, Sophie Devine goes for the pull shot but it takes the top edge and flies behind the keeper for a boundary Moves to 63!
Width there outside off, it's guided down to third man for a run.
Short and wide outside off, Sophie jumps and smashes it over covers but only for a run.
Around off, on a good length, Sophie Devine defends it from the back foot.
Full and angling in around middle, helped to mid-wicket.
Fuller and around off, Green drives it towards the cover fielder who stretches her right hand and deflects it towards mid on. They cross.
Short and around off, turning away, Green rocks back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Wide! Way wide outside off, turning away, Green leaves.
Fuller and around off, driven down to mid off.
Brilliant delivery, a good loop on this one. It lands around off and spins away as Green pushes at it and misses.
Full and around leg, swept to deep mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Shot! Sune Luus is pushing her luck too much. Got a wicket with a rank full toss and serves another here. It's on middle and Sophie Devine nails her sweep shot in front of square on the leg side for a boundary.
Loopy and full, around off, Sophie Devine gets forward and drives it to mid off.
Short and around off, Green leans back and allows it through to the keeper.
Wide! 7th of the innings by South Africa Women. Down the leg side, on a good length, it's left alone.
It's been a struggle for Maddy Green to rotate the strike. A yorker around middle, Green digs it out down to mid on.
Fuller and closer to off, Green drives it to covers.
Back of a length, on off, Devine stays back and dabs it down to third man for a run.
Fullish and around off, Green drives it to the left of mid off and takes a single.
Wide! Marizanne Kapp loses her radar and slips a length ball down the leg side, Green tries to pull but misses.
Starts with a length ball on middle, Sophie Devine works it in front of square leg and collects a single.
Marizanne Kapp is back into the attack now. She has given 13 runs in her four overs so far.
Flatter and shorter around off, Green allows it to spin and then cuts but finds the point fielder.
Full toss and around off, swept to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Short and outside off, Sophie cuts but finds the cover fielder.
Quicker and flatter around leg, it's pushed away to cover-point for a quick run.
A low full toss, around off and drifting in, Green walks forward and drives but still finds the cover fielder.
Tossed up, around off, pushed to covers.
A half-tracker outside off, Green goes back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Five dots! Short and around off, Green plays late but finds the point fielder.
Flatter and on off, pushed away to short cover.
A touch short and around off, Green plays late and cuts it towards point.
Loopy and full around leg, it's driven back to the bowler.
Play and a miss! Arm ball, close to off, Green tries to cut but misses.
Flighted and full, around off, defended to the cover fielder.

FOUR! Fifty for Sophie Devine! A very good knock by the White Ferns skipper. Back-to-back boundaries for her. This is a full toss on leg. Devine gets low and paddle-sweeps it towards the long leg region for a boundary.

FOUR! Devine gets the much-needed boundary! A half-tracker on middle. Devine pulls it towards the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary. The fielder in the deep makes a valiant effort to stop it with a dive but fails and it's a boundary in the end.
100 up for New Zealand Women! A slightly shorter delivery, outside off. Green cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
A flatter delivery on off. Green plays it back to the bowler.
This is pushed quicker outside off. Green squeezes it towards the off side.
A flatter delivery once more, on off. Green drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
A flatter delivery on middle. Devine works it towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Slightly shorter outside off. Green cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.

Ohh...it carries back to the bowler but a very difficult chance! A loopy full toss around off, Green hits it back to the bowler. It goes very low and to the left to the bowler. She tries to catch it but fails as the ball hits her boot. A single is taken as the ball gets deflected to the off side.
A flatter and slightly shorter delivery on off. Devine hits this straight down the ground. The ball hits the stumps and it deflects wide of mid off, for a single.
Slower in the air, on off. Devine hits this without much timing back to the bowler.
Yet another bowling change. Chloe Tryon is back on. 4-0-30-0 are her figures so far.
Another nicely flighted delivery on off. Green drives it back to Luus again.
Tossed up on off. Green plays it back to the bowler.
Slightly short and flatter. Devine goes back and punches it to long on for a single.
Ohh...a shocker of a delivery! A full toss on middle. Green swipes it to deep square leg for a single.
Slower and loopy delivery on off. Green defends it towards the off side.
Short and wide outside off. Devine cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Sune Luus (1 for 10 in 2 overs) is back on. She is ringing in the changes and not allowing the batters to get used to one bowler.
Excellent over, just two runs from it. Serves this on a length, on off. Green only manages to defend this onto the pitch.
Pulls her length back a little, on off. Green is solid in her defence.
Goes fuller again, on off. Green drives it to mid off. Dot again!
Pitches this one up, on middle. Green pushes it towards mid on.
Slightly shorter outside off. Green cuts it through backward point for a couple.
A length delivery, on off. Green blocks this off the front foot.

Brilliantly done by Shabnim Ismail! A maiden over! After bowling wide deliveries outside off, she brings this one into the batter from a length. On middle and leg. Devine misses the push and gets hit on the pads. They appeal but it's turned down as the ball is sliding down the leg side.
Shabnim Ismail continues with bowling back of a length, outside off. Devine looks to cut but fails to make any contact.
Well, four dot balls now! Short and wide outside off. Devine cuts but finds the point fielder again.
On the shorter side again, around off. Devine rides the bounce and punches it to point yet again.
Short and wide outside off. Devine gets the desired timing on her cut shot this time but the placement is not there.
Back of a length, outside off. Devine looks to cut but fails to get the desired timing.
Shabnim Ismail (4-0-6-1) is brought back into the attack. This is smart thinking from Sune Luus, getting her main bowlers to create further inroads with the one end open now.
Short and wide outside off, cut from the back foot but to cover-point. End of a successful over.
Around off, on a length, defended back.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, Green tries flicking but misses.
In the channel outside off, moving away, Maddy tries chasing but misses.
On a length and around off, Green is forward in defense.
Wide! Shortish and wide outside off, left alone.
Maddy Green is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! What a bowling change by Sune Luus, truly inspirational. All of a sudden, South Africa Women have got two wickets and are back on top. This one is served on a good length, close to off and angling away, Amy Satterthwaite tries to cut close to her body but only manages an outside edge to the keeper. Trisha Chetty makes no mistake and New Zealand Women have lost a couple of big wickets in the space of 4 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Trisha Chetty b Ayabonga Khaka

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller in length, outside off, pushed to covers.
A half-tracker first up against Amy Satterthwaite, on middle. She pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Amy Satterthwaite walks in at number 4.

OUT! PLUMB LBW! Sune Luus strikes for her team to break the 81-run stand. Won't call it a wicket-taking delivery, it's more of a mistake from the batter to miss out on a straightforward full toss. Nicely tossed up, around middle, Amelia Kerr goes down to sweep but misses and is pinged on the front pad. They appeal and the finger has gone up. No DRS is taken by Amelia Kerr as she walks back after having a word with Sophie Devine. South Africa Women desperately needed this breakthrough and would now like to regain some control.
Loopy and full, around off, Kerr drives it to covers.
A low full toss around middle, it's swept through square leg for a run.
Gets on the front foot and pushes it to cover-point.
Full and floated around off, defended off the front foot.
Skidding in from around off, punched away to covers.
Flatter and around off, pushed to covers.
FOUR! Plenty of loop on this delivery, turns out to be a high full toss down the leg side, Amelia Kerr goes down on one knee and powers it down to fine leg for a boundary.
Plays late. Allows the ball to spin away and guides it wide of short third man for two.
Another short delivery, outside off and spinning away, smashed to sweeper cover for a single.
Short in length and outside off, cut to deep cover for one.
Goes on the back foot to a short ball and punches it with the spin to sweeper cover for a single.

Drinks! South Africa Women badly needed this break. After a good spell of seam-bowling by their opening bowling pair, other bowlers have failed to keep control. 48 runs have come after Powerplay 1 and New Zealand Women have recovered well after an early wicket. Injury to Klass has not helped South Africa's cause and they need to tighten things up, otherwise, the game can drift away from them quite quickly.
Wide! Drifting down the leg side, Amelia Kerr tries to sweep but misses.
Turning away from around off, Kerr gets back to cut but it takes the outer edge and rolls towards short third man.
Sune Luus continues to be short, outside off, Devine drags it down to long on for a run.
Aerial but safe! Short again, spinning away from around off, Kerr cuts it aerially but over covers for one.

It's looking all too easy at the moment for the White Ferns. Short in length again, around leg, Kerr turns inside the crease and helps it down to fine leg. Mignon du Preez makes a sliding stop near the fence and saves two.
Starts with a short ball outside off, Kerr gets back and guides it wide of short third man for a couple of runs.
The skipper, Sune Luus brings herself into the attack now.
FOUR! Ferocious! Very full in length, around off, Sophie Devine drills it down the ground, past her partner at the other end and it races away to the long on fence in no time.
Short in length and outside off, Devine chops down her attempted square cut to point.
EDGY FOUR! Short again from Chloe Tryon, it's outside off, Sophie Devine rocks back to cut and it flies off the outside edge to the third man boundary.
Loopy and full around middle, Sophie Devine drives it back to the bowler who deflects it to mid-wicket.
Short and wide outside off, Devine tries to cut but misses.
Flighted and full, around off, driven through covers for a single.
On the shorter side again, on off. Kerr goes back and makes some room to punch it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Masabata Klaas is holding her shoulder as she leaves the field. Not good signs for South Africa Women.
WIDE! Goes shorter and down the leg side. Kerr looks to pull it but misses. Trisha Chetty collects the ball moving to her left.
Serves this on a length, on middle. Kerr works it through mid-wicket for a couple.
She finds the good length now, on off. Kerr tries to guide it towards the off side but gets the inside edge onto her pads.
Pitches this one up, on off. Kerr drives it to mid off.
On the shorter side again, around off. Kerr cuts it to cover-point.
FOUR! Klaas has not found her rhythm today! A shorter delivery on middle. Kerr pulls it towards the backward square leg region for a boundary. 50 runs partnership comes up.
Masabata Klaas returns. She went for 11 runs in her opening over.
A flatter delivery and quicker too, around off. Devine looks to cut but mistimes it.
Shorter and outside off again. Kerr cuts it to sweeper cover for a single again.
A flatter delivery outside off. Devine cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Skidding down around leg, Devine tries to flick but misses.
Floated and full, around leg, it's swept behind square leg for two. 50 up!
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for South Africa Women! Poor delivery, an arm ball outside off but on the shorter side, Sophie Devine rocks back and whacks it through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Deft! This is on a length, outside off. Kerr plays late and beats the keeper. Good timing and it races away to the third man fence.
On middle this time. Kerr works it towards the leg side.

Dropped but a tough chance for the keeper! Slightly shorter length again, outside off. Kerr looks to cut but gets the toe end of her blade. The ball goes to Trisha Chetty, who is standing up to the stumps, but she fails to grab it.
On the shorter side again, outside off. Kerr looks to cut but misses.
Slightly shorter outside off. Kerr cuts it towards cover-point. Not in the gap.

Khaka starts her new over with a length delivery, around off. Kerr defends it towards backward point and takes a single. There is a direct hit at the batter's end and the ball deflects behind the stumps. The batters take an extra run. Good awareness from Amelia Kerr who never took her eyes off the ball and called for the second run.
Pushed quicker on middle. Devine is solid in her front-foot defence.
Flatter and on middle and leg. Kerr works it to long leg for a single.
FOUR! Powerful cut shot and in the gap now! Slightly short again, outside off. Kerr is waiting for it and smacks it through covers for a boundary.
Goes slightly shorter this time, outside off. Kerr cuts but finds the fielder at covers.
Another loopy delivery on off. Kerr drives it to covers.
Tryon starts with a tossed-up delivery, outside off. Kerr lets it go.
Change in bowling. One expensive over from Masabata Klaas and she has been removed from the attack. South Africa Women looking to take the pace off the ball. In comes Chloe Tryon.
Another dot to end the over! A fullish one, outside off. Devine drives but finds the fielder at cover in the ring.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Devine connects with the cut shot this time but hits it straight to the fielder at point.
A length delivery, outside off. Devine tries to cut it but misses.
Delivers this on a length, around off. Devine drives it to covers.
FOUR! This time she finds the gap! Khaka pulls her length back a little and delivers it outside off. Devine cuts it through covers for a boundary.
Khaka serves this full, outside off. Devine drives it to cover-point.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over.

FOUR! Runs came thick and fast in the last over of Powerplay 1! Short in length and wide outside off, Amelia Kerr crunches her square cut through the gap at point for a boundary. 11 from the over, New Zealand Women are 30/1!
Up and over, Kerr showing good intent! Full and around off, angling in, Amelia Kerr lofts it over mid on. The fielder chases it down near the fence and they take a couple of runs.
Around off, on a good length, Amelia Kerr defends it from the crease.
Uppish but safe! Fuller again, outside off, Devine tries to drive but ends up slicing it off the outer edge. It beats the dive of Laura Wolvaardt at point and they get a single.
Pitches it up and close to off, Sophie Devine drives it down the ground but finds mid off.
FOUR! Devine gets the second boundary of the match! Fuller in length and wide outside off, Devine reaches out for it and smashes it through the gap at covers for a boundary.
So bowling change from both ends. Masabata Klaas is brought into the attack now.
Fullish and around off, Kerr defends it back off the front foot. Ayabonga Khaka starts with a maiden!
Misses out! Short and wide outside off, Amelia Kerr cracks it off the her back foot but finds the point fielder again.
Fuller and outside off, driven off the front foot to wide mid off.
Outside off, played down to point.
Pitches it up and around off, Amelia Kerr drives but again finds the fielder, this time at covers.
Ayabonga Khaka begins with a delivery on the fuller side outside off, Amelia Kerr hits it off the front foot but finds the fielder at cover-point.
Effort delivery again, short and close to off, Sophie Devine leans back and drops her hands to let it through.
First bowling change of the game. Ayabonga Khaka comes into the attack now.
Wide called for height! A bouncer goes well over the head of the batter who ducks.
Kapp goes wide of the crease and angles in a full ball on middle, Sophie Devine defends it from the crease.
A bit short and outside off, played down to point.
Movement off the pitch. It lands on a good length around off, Sophie Devine defends it from the inner half of her bat.

FOUR! Slapped away! Marizanne Kapp hurls across a short delivery, wide outside off, Sophie Devine buys the width and slaps it past the diving backward point fielder for a boundary - first of the match.
Delivers it on a good length, close to off and shaping in, Sophie Devine stays on the back foot and keeps it out safely.
Slightly short and around off, Amelia Kerr punches it off the back foot to point. Tidy over!
Serves it on a length around off, Amelia Kerr defends it off her back foot.
Shabnim Ismail goes short and serves it around off, Amelia Kerr drags her attempted pull shot, past the mid-wicket fielder, and returns for the second run.
Around off, on a length and angling in, Kerr plays late and taps it down towards backward point.
Digs it in short, wide outside off, Amelia Kerr allows it through as an afterthought.
Short and wide outside off, Devine plays a mistimed punch off the back foot. It goes to the left of mid off and they cross.

Play and a miss! Marizanne Kapp drops it on a length and outside off, some late away movement on this delivery, Amelia Kerr pushes at it tamely and misses. It's been a circumspect start from the White Ferns.
Edgy! Full and wide outside off, Sophie throws her bat at it and edges it down to third man. It doesn't carry to the fielder in the deep. Another single taken.
Marizanne Kapp is a bit too straight with her line, around middle, Amelia Kerr walks across and tickles it behind square leg for a single. She is off the mark!
Lands it on a good length and close to off, Amelia Kerr defends it from the back foot again.
Another length ball is angled in around off, Amelia Kerr blocks it from the back foot.
Angles in a length ball, around off, Sophie defends it to the off side. The ball rolls in the gap at extra cover and they cross.
Slightly shorter in length, around off. Kerr blocks this towards the off side.
She is staying around that good length and pitches this one on a good length again, outside off. Kerr leaves it alone.
Tight line! On a length, on off. Kerr gets well forward and blocks it.
Pulls her length back a little, outside off. Kerr leaves it alone.
A fullish length, outside off. Kerr drives it towards the off side but fails to get the desired timing.
Overpitched delivery on off at 122 kph. Devine drives it to mid off and takes a single.
Hits the hard length, around off. Kerr blocks this towards the off side.
A good-length delivery, outside off and seaming away. Kerr lets it go.

Pitches this on a length, on middle. Sophie Devine pushes it to mid on and sets off for a single. It is a risky run and a direct hit would have been tricky for Devine. However, no damage was done in the end.
This time it is on a good length and it seams into Devine. She leaves it alone.
On a length and close to off, Sophie Devine gets back to cut but only manages to chop it down off the bottom edge. It rolls away to cover-point.
Fuller in length and around off, Devine presses forward and pushes it defensively to mid off.
A good-length delivery, outside off. Kerr goes chasing for it but misses.
Back of a length, around off. Kerr dabs it towards point.
Amelia Kerr, the batter in prime form, walks in next.

OUT! BOWLED! Finally, she pitches this one up and gets the desired result, Shabnim Ismail strikes early! This one is on a fuller length around off. Bates goes for a big booming drive but the ball swings quite a bit into her. There is a gap left between bat and pad, and the ball beats the inside edge of her blade to shatter the stumps. Big wicket for South Africa Women. Smart bowling from Shabnim Ismail, she was getting the ball to curve away and surprised the batter with a big inswinger. Suzie Bates didn't pick it at all and the look on her face tells the entire story. Outplayed.
Back of a length again, outside off. Devine steers it towards third man for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Devine punches this off the back foot again towards the off side but fails to find the gap.
On a length, around off at 113 kph. Devine punches it without much timing towards the off side.
Early signs but there is a hint of movement for the pacers. Shabnim Ismail was a bit on the shorter side and should look to pitch it up here.
On a length and drifting into pads. Devine works it right of square leg for a single.
It goes away from Sophie Devine now. This is on a good length, outside off. Sophie Devine leaves it alone watchfully.
A fullish delivery on middle this time and a hint of inswing. Bates drives this off the inside half of her blade towards deep backward square leg for a single.
This time she finds the gap! A fullish delivery, around off. Bates leans forward and drives it through covers for a couple before the fielder cuts it off.
Pulls her length back this time and serves this around off. Bates punches it towards the off side.
She starts with a full delivery outside off and it shapes away. Bates goes chasing for it but misses.
Marizanne Kapp to bowl from the opposite end.
On a length again, around middle with some extra bounce at 110 kph. Sophie Devine defends this onto the pitch. Decent start by Shabnim Ismail.
On a length, on middle at 119 kph. Sophie Devine blocks it solidly towards mid on.
On the shorter side again, around off. Sophie Devine rides the bounce and punches it towards cover-point.
A good-length delivery, outside off. Sophie Devine leaves it alone.
A full delivery on middle this time at 108 kph. Bates drives it right of mid off for a single. New Zealand Women and Suzie Bates are underway!
Ismail starts with a back-of-a-length delivery, outside off. Bates looks to cut it but mistimes it towards the off side. This is a fresh pitch and Shabnim Ismail will love bowling here.

Done and dusted with the pre-match formalities. It's time to dive in. The Protea Women get into a huddle before taking the field. Mignon du Preez is playing her 150th ODIs. The players from both groups take the knee against racism, as has been the norm these days. Suzie Bates and Sophie Devine are the openers for New Zealand Women. Shabnim Ismail to speed in with the first new ball. Two slips waiting. Let's play...

Lovely conditions at the Seddon Park greet the players on the ground. It's a gorgeous day! First up, it's time to play the anthems of both the countries. South Africa's first followed by New Zealand's.

Pitch report - The pitch is more to the centre and one side of the boundary is on the shorter side. The surface is beautiful and there are no footmarks. It looks flat and has plenty of runs in it. It could help the spinners later on. As a batting team, you need to be careful at the start and the runs will come.

South Africa Women (Unchanged Playing XI) - Lizelle Lee, Laura Wolvaardt, Tazmin Brits, Sune Luus (C), Mignon du Preez, Marizanne Kapp, Chloe Tryon, Trisha Chetty (WK), Shabnim Ismail, Masabata Klaas, Ayabonga Khaka.

New Zealand Women (Playing XI) - Suzie Bates, Sophie Devine (C), Amelia Kerr, Amy Satterthwaite, Maddy Green, Frances Mackay, Katey Martin (WK), Brooke Halliday (In place of Hayley Jensen), Hannah Rowe, Lea Tahuhu, Jess Kerr.

Sunne Luus, the skipper of South Africa Women, says they would have batted first as well but it will not make much difference and they will now look to chase it down. She adds that they are improving every day, especially with the bat and have shown their class with the ball. She mentions that they are looking to start fresh and calls it a new contest. Informs that they are going with the unchanged XI.

Sophie Devine, the captain of New Zealand Women, says that they are batting as the pitch looks like a ripper again and they want to put runs on the board and defend. Tells that every game is important and they have to perform at their best to beat the White Ferns. Mentions that they have taken a lot of learnings from the last game. Informs that Brooke Halliday comes in for Hayley Jensen.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of New Zealand Women. They have elected to BAT first.

The hosts, New Zealand, on the other hand, have not been able to put consistent performances in the middle so far. Being a home World Cup, expectations are quite high from the White Ferns and they need to step up their game as one more loss here can make things tricky for them. They have a well-balanced team with plenty of all-round options but they need to execute their skills better on the field to cross the line against a strong South African unit. Will they bring their A-game on the table against a team that has been unbeaten so far in this World Cup? Or will South Africa Women continue to march on? We shall find out. Toss and team sheets in a while.

South Africa Women are riding high at the moment with three wins in three games so far and would be looking to continue the momentum forward. The biggest positive for them has been their performance under pressure in crunch situations and that has meant that despite not performing to their full potential, they have managed to cross the line. Their seamers have been top-notch and with the batting unit showing good composure in their previous game, the Proteas are looking like a side to beat so far in this World Cup.

Hello and a warm welcome to game number 16 of the Women’s World Cup 2022 where New Zealand Women will lock horns against South Africa Women. The qualification race for the semis is getting tighter and tighter and this is another such encounter that can have huge implications in deciding the top four teams at the end of the league stage. This game is critical especially for the White Ferns as they have been blowing hot and cold in the tournament so far and let's see how things pan out between two evenly-matched teams.
... MATCH DAY …
